I don't have any notes for you yet. None of my searches returned usable results, so I haven't read a single source page.

My first search call failed because of a bug in my own code: I misread the format of the results. When I tried again, the tool told me I had used up my search and fetch calls for this turn. The other tools I have can't reach the internet, so I couldn't look at Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), StudyLight, Precept Austin, the NET Bible notes or the Catholic and Orthodox sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse-by-verse notes, because any I wrote now would have no sources behind them.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll start over. I plan to:
1. Fetch the verse-by-verse commentaries first: the Enduring Word page on Nehemiah 12, and Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and others on Bible Hub and StudyLight.
2. Check Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes, especially for v. 22 (which Darius, and the dates for Jaddua) and v. 23 (the "Book of the Chronicles").
3. Look on the tradition-specific and Catholic/Orthodox sites for views that really differ. With a list of names like this, there may be few or none, and if so I'll say that.
4. Write the notes as "v. 1: …", with the source URL after each point.
